text:
maya: Hey team — need to enable full request/response capture in the staging proxy for a private-customer replay. Only for 48h. Will probably include token/prompt fields. Config I was going to push:
```yaml
capture:
  sample: all
  redact:
    headers: ["Authorization"]
    prompt_snippet: first_200
  sink: s3://redwood-temp-llm-debug/txn-9876/
```
Can security sign off? TL;DR: customer cannot reproduce locally, need full trace to debug.

alex: What's the minimum fields we need? Can we avoid capturing Authorization header & full PII? Who will access the bucket?

sam: +1 on access list. Also need an audit ticket and ephemeral creds. Who's oncall for this customer?

katie-security: We need justification, least-privilege, retention, and a masking strategy for tokens and emails. If tokens must be redacted, prefer removing full tokens and storing HMAC instead (store only first 6 chars). Also require S3 SSE + bucket policy + SIEM alert on access. See our redaction guide: https://intra/docs/security/log-redaction

jordan-infra: We can create an ephemeral bucket with lifecycle 48h and KMS encryption. Recommend put-object events -> audit-log and restrict to role:eng/debug-llm. I can provision if you give list of principals.

maya: OK, going to limit to 3 engineers for the debug: maya, ryan, taylor and security oncall katie-security. Retention 48h. I'll replace Authorization with hmac(token) before write. Ticket: INT-5124 (https://issues/redwood/INT-5124). Customer id: cust-789. :wave:

katie-security: Conditional APPROVE: proceed if all below are implemented:
- Authorization header replaced with HMAC (store only prefix)
- prompts truncated to 200 chars and stored as prompt_snippet
- emails and phone numbers redacted via regex before sink
- Bucket has KMS + access logged to SIEM; lifecycle = 48h
- Post-run audit doc in INT-5124 with 1) who accessed 2) queries run 3) artifacts + deletion confirmation
If all that, approved until 2026-03-20T16:00Z. :white_check_mark:

sam: I can add the IAM role and CloudTrail alert. Will patch role:eng/debug-llm with STS session duration 1h and require session tag "ticket=INT-5124". Once infra finishes I'll ping for final go.

maya: Thanks team. I'll hold on deploy until infra confirms and then do a 1-min smoke test. Will post results in the ticket.

audit-bot: Audit log created INT-5124-access -> initial request by maya at 2723456789
